signals.usability_note: Clear view of a single-story ranch house frontage from the street, partially obscured by a large tree trunk and foliage in the foreground.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed rounded shrubs along the foundation and a stone-edged mulch ring around the tree look tidy, but this is common homeowner upkeep and no crew or equipment is visible.

signals.notes: Well-kept ranch with yellow siding and green shutters, attached garage at right, and a mature shade tree in the front lawn; the neighboring house on the left has blue recycling bins at the side.
